shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清主体与配线，抢点击
把主体放进真实办公桌，让买家自我代入使用情境
保留双栏刻度盘对照结构，用空白仪表与空标签承载可验证主张
用配线剖面与外壳剖视证明做工与用料，解释机制
一立一平双视角加三联小图交代折叠插脚、配线与接口，消除体积疑虑
用无机型名的空白适配表与通用设备剪影承接兼容诉求，降下单风险
墙插内构剖视加一排空白防护图标收口，把安全感留到最后

style.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, pale stone grey #EDEBE8 for desk and cutaway screens, mist blue #E9F2FB for the twin comparison panel; one flat colour field per shot, no gradients or random interiors
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside circles, accent blue #2E7BD6 only, one icon row per screen, no filled or shaded glyphs
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool high-key studio light, large soft frontal key from the upper left with a white fill card, gentle contact shadows only, controlled speculars limited to metal parts, one consistent light direction per shot
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean premium tech accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale stone grey #EDEBE8, mist blue panel #E9F2FB and one cool accent blue #2E7BD6 with graphite text #2D3238; neutral-cool high-key studio lighting, large soft frontal key from the upper left with a white fill card, gentle contact shadows, controlled speculars only on metal; modern geometric sans-serif with all marketing copy removed and every label left as a blank bar or empty cell; thin single-weight circular line icons in accent blue only; stable rounded rectangular brick scale and three-quarter read; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no numbers or certification seals inside the frame.
noDrift: no numbers, units, badges or seals rendered inside the frame
style.presentationRules: compact rounded rectangular brick shown at one stable scale and one stable three-quarter read across the set, paired cable always coiled the same way, port opening and folding prongs visible whenever the geometry allows
style.surfaceSystem: white-veined marble desktop #EDEBE8, matte cool-white studio steps #F3F5F8, large-format stone wall #E4E7EA
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; all source marketing copy stripped, in-image wording left as blank bars, empty caption slots and empty table cells to be typeset in post
